More important, I have a gift.''"<br />"''And this is&mdash;?''"<br />"''It contains my voiceporint, which will key a hoverpod in slip thirty, in the second-floor garage. '''Gnosos''' was a male [[Sunesi]] who worked as a [[CorDuro Shipping]] steward on [[Bburru Station]]<ref name="Balance Point" /> in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].</ref> He did not support the company when they decided to turn [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] over to the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. He helped [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] escape imprisonment by [[Durgard Brarun]] by providing him with a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] with clearance to access [[Port Duggan]].<ref name="Balance Point" />
